SOURCE: Canada, Post Office Department, Annual Report 1914-1915.
        Internet Archive item n24annualreport1915cana, full djvu text downloaded 2026-09-06.
        This file holds ONLY the two passages naming Kanawana, with their table headings and
        enough surrounding lines to show the alphabetical run. The rest of the volume is unread.
